A 22: next/this weekday

A 33: no discount/waiver/plan
A 34-35: read back, "Do you confirm?"

A 37: retry once, then service_error
A 38: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
A 39 + B 9: already paid
A 40 + B 9: dispute
A 41 + B 10: restructuring
A 42: human, ask once first, queue general
A 43: scam
A 44: cannot answer
A 45: refuse to talk twice
A 46 outcome table
A: transfer after recorded promise -> transferred
A: never uses add_note (overridden by B 8)
A 47: goodbye before close_call
B 1: one to three products
B 2: state every late product first
B 3: band/deadline per product
B 4: ask all today once, then product by product
B 5: attempts per product
B 6: common date clamped to each product's deadline
